name: SUSE
summary:
SUSE provides enterprise open source platforms for Kubernetes, Linux, edge, and cloud-native infrastructure environments.

Together, we help organisations design, integrate, and operate SUSE technologies across secure cloud, hybrid, and on-premises infrastructure platforms. From SUSE Linux Enterprise and Rancher through to Kubernetes platform operations and infrastructure management, we help teams create environments that are reliable, scalable, and operationally consistent.
overview:
SUSE technologies support many modern enterprise infrastructure and cloud-native platforms.

Together, we help organisations build, integrate, and operate SUSE environments across cloud, hybrid, edge, and on-premises infrastructure. From SUSE Linux Enterprise and Rancher through to Kubernetes management and platform operations, we help teams create environments that are secure, scalable, and operationally consistent.

Our focus is on building strong platform foundations that support long-term infrastructure operations. This includes Kubernetes management, automation, observability, lifecycle management, platform security, and operational enablement across complex environments.

We help organisations reduce operational complexity, improve resilience, and deliver modern infrastructure platforms with confidence.
